title: csdata
text: csdata holds reference tables Norwegian surveillance work needs : places exist, nest inside ; place boundaries redistricted 2006 2024; many people live place, age sex. Every table ships inside package, function call downloads data. analysis stops carrying copy lookups. csdata exports thirteen objects. five work. five take border argument. 2024 value accept. value stops error.

title: csdata
text: BA-regions missing hierarchy table. nor_locations_names() lists 159 BA-regions, nor_locations_hierarchy_from_to() accepts "baregion". bundled hierarchy table carries BA-region codes . Every /pair names "baregion" therefore returns empty table instead error. One location code used twice. Two different laboratories share code lab_nor084467. matters pass nor_locations_names() location_reference, lookup join location_code. duplicated code matches twice, get values back put . add_granularity_geo_to_data_set() fails, tries write four values three-row table. Leave location_reference unset avoid problems. granularity comes code prefix, one value per input.

title: Norwegian population aggregated into custom age categories — nor_population_by_age_cats
text: cats named unnamed list integer vectors give age values include category. vector element defines one age band. list element named, name becomes age label. named, label "LLL_HHH": zero-padded lower upper bounds. Defaults NULL (custom bands; "total" returned include_total = TRUE). include_total Logical. TRUE (default), function appends extra row group age = "total" covers ages. include_9999 Logical. TRUE, function duplicates recent calendar year adds calyear = 9999. follows cstidy convention granularity_time == "event_*". Default FALSE. border Integer. geographic border year. Valid values: 2024. Defaults csdata::config$border_nor.

title: Norwegian population aggregated into custom age categories — nor_population_by_age_cats
text: data.table columns: granularity_geo Geographic granularity level. location_code Location code. age Age category label, derived cats names auto-generated, plus "total" include_total = TRUE. sex Sex. Always "total", function filters bundled dataset sex total. dataset also holds "male" "female"; reach nor_population_by_sex_age_cats(). calyear Calendar year. pop_jan1_n Population count 1 January calyear. imputed Logical. TRUE value imputed.

title: Norwegian population aggregated into custom age categories — nor_population_by_age_cats

title: Population in Norway by sex and age categories — nor_population_by_sex_age_cats
text: cats list vectors give age values include category. include_total_age Logical. TRUE, function includes "total" age category. include_total_sex Logical. TRUE, function includes "total" (sexes combined) sex, alongside "male" "female". include_9999 Logical. TRUE, function duplicates current calendar year adds calyear = 9999. follows cstidy convention granularity_time == "event_*". border Integer. Norwegian geographic border year. Valid values: 2024.

title: Population in Norway by sex and age categories — nor_population_by_sex_age_cats
text: data.table containing following columns: granularity_geo location_code age (specified argument "cats") sex ("male", "female", "total" include_total_sex) calyear pop_jan1_n imputed

title: Population in Norway by sex and age categories — nor_population_by_sex_age_cats
text: Statistics Norway provides sex breakdown Svalbard Jan Mayen (notmainlandcounty_nor21, notmainlandcounty_nor22, notmainlandmunicip_nor2100, notmainlandmunicip_nor2200). four codes pop_jan1_n NA male female rows, total row holds real count. unknown-location codes (missingcounty_nor99, missingmunicip_nor9999) pop_jan1_n NA three sex rows, total included. include_total_sex = TRUE, output holds male, female total long format. sum pop_jan1_n across sex values therefore double-counts. Filter single sex, sum male/female components.
